method: PATH restricted to package and Windows system directories; no Qt/build PATH; native Windows QPA

commands.stdout:
Usage: E:\codex\klogg\.local\dist\klogg-longline-windows-x64\klogg.exe [options]
Klogg log viewer

Options:
  -?, -h, --help             Displays help on commandline options.
  --help-all                 Displays help, including generic Qt options.
  -v, --version              Displays version information.
  -d, --debug <debug_level>  output more debug (increase number for more
                             verbosity)
  -m, --multi                allow multiple instance of klogg to run
                             simultaneously (use together with -s)
  -s, --load-session         load the previous session (default when no file is
                             passed)
  -n, --new-session          do not load the previous session (default when a
                             file is passed)
  -l, --log                  save the log to a file
  -f, --follow               follow initial opened files
  --window-width <1024>      new window width
  --window-height <768>      new window height
